text:
Grab's full-time headcount grew from 11,267 as of December 31, 2024 to 12,012 as of December 31, 2025 — an increase of 745 employees, or about 6.6% [Grab, FY2024, p.161; Grab, FY2025, p.117].

By function, the growth was uneven:
- General and administrative: 1,425 → 1,375 (down 50)
- Sales and marketing: 853 → 785 (down 68)
- Operations, support and supermarket retail: 6,055 → 6,888 (up 833)
- Research and development: 2,934 → 2,964 (up 30)

Note that the 2025 total includes 865 employees from Everrise (a Malaysian supermarket chain acquired in March 2025) and 22 employees from Infermove (an AI robotics startup acquired in December 2025), which largely explains the increase in the Operations, support and supermarket retail category [Grab, FY2025, p.117]. The 2024 total similarly included 321 employees from the Nham24 acquisition [Grab, FY2024, p.161].
